🤖 **Agent note** · triaged — re-confirmed real, design still unstarted (v1 has landed since the last triage)
- **Agent:** repo queue worker (repo-worker-code), OpenChamber scheduled lane `02cafe76-eafd-4d0b-aaa6-2b7a737d68dc`
- **Session / ID:** OpenCode session `ses_e5e46542b44ffekacQRnvTFFnp`; task 12294 (triage)
- **Task:** task 12294 — re-triage of issue #5789 under Drew's triage doctrine (code#7016): the earlier triage (task 10192) was correct but produced no landed design work, and the previous claim of this task parked on the stale `opencode` execution-lane assignment.
- **Fresh verification (2026-11-08 ~05:50Z, origin/main `99f326a055`, read-only):**
  - #5789 is OPEN, no hard-stop labels (`held`, `user/owned`, `do-not-merge`, `do-not-auto-edit` all absent).
  - **The premise has moved:** #5545 (v1 view projection + discovery query) is now **CLOSED** (2026-11-07T12:23Z) and its work has landed — `pkgs/id/src/idset.rs` now carries `pub mod expand` and `pub mod view`, and `idset/view.rs` implements frontier-pinned projection (`GroupMembers` with `(group, frontier, resolution)`, `ExpandedWriters` with exclusions winning, "expansion does not recurse"). So the v1 shapes #5789 said it must precede are now in the tree — the representation questions in this issue are live, not hypothetical.
  - **Still absent (the v2 scope):** no view-as-object kind, no set algebra (union/intersection/difference with provenance), no federation of set entries across servers, no discovery over views/sets. `idset.rs`'s own module docs still say counting is a later slice and expansion is non-recursive.
  - No open PR or branch owns this: no `queue/*5789*` PR for this design (PR #7231/#3888 carry the `5789` prefix only as a queue-id coincidence on unrelated `currency.rate_authorisation` work), and no `writer sets v2` PR exists.
- **Decision:** CONFIRMED real and current, and now **more actionable than at the last triage** because v1 has landed. Re-queued as a design packet scoped to this issue's own sketch: view-as-object (what is referenced and what a referencing view counts when the source changes), set algebra with provenance and cycle refusal, federation via #5675/#5672, discovery v2 with the uncounted-side honesty rule, and the composition amplification abuse shape. Coordinate with open #5672 and #5675; #2238 is the closed v1 spec to extend.
- **Links:** task 12294 · issue #5789 · follow-up design task (see queue) · related #5545 (closed, landed), #2238 (closed spec), #5672, #5675
